evals.prompt: Use the animation-opportunity-scan skill on this app: a command palette opened via Cmd+K used constantly throughout the day with no transition; a live analytics line chart that redraws instantly on new data; and a settings modal that appears/disappears instantly.
evals.expected_output: Rejects animating the command palette (keyboard-triggered, 100+/day) and the analytics chart (functional data being read), while accepting the settings modal as a legitimate occasional-frequency candidate.

assertions.text: Rejects the command palette as a candidate
Names the keyboard/high-frequency reason for rejecting the command palette
Rejects or excludes the analytics chart as functional data
Accepts the settings modal as a suggestion

evals.prompt: Use the animation-opportunity-scan skill on a settings drawer component (Drawer.vue) that currently appears and disappears instantly with a v-if toggle, opened occasionally from a settings icon.
evals.expected_output: Suggests a specific entrance/exit recipe for the drawer with an exact duration and easing/transform values, not a vague 'add some animation' recommendation.

assertions.text: Gives a concrete duration value in milliseconds
Names a specific animated property or transform

evals.prompt: Use the animation-opportunity-scan skill on a dense internal reporting dashboard where every element is a data table or number that updates on a fixed refresh cycle, viewed by ops staff dozens of times per shift for fast scanning.
evals.expected_output: Finds few or no genuine opportunities given the high-frequency, data-scanning nature of the surface, and says so plainly rather than inventing speculative suggestions just to fill the table.

assertions.text: Acknowledges the surface needs little or no motion
